prose: Burn 0.22 is a release of the Rust deep-learning framework. It removes backend type parameters from user code via burn-dispatch, speeds rebuilds up to 15x in the team's tests, and improves CPU and GPU execution with adaptive memory, better autotuning and graph replay. It also adds a CubeCL Environment that reuses warmed caches, LoRA and QLoRA adaptation, ONNX export and wider remote compute support.
highlights: No backend generics in user code; rebuilds up to 15x faster.
Adaptive memory, smarter autotuning, graph replay.
Adds LoRA/QLoRA, ONNX export, remote compute.
Basis: first part of the release post.
